496:t_10:21.en:
$$バナージ$$
($$カミーユ$$ is really relentless today...)

496:t_10:22.en:
$$シン$$
(I'm not saying it's like $$クェス$$ earlier, but $$カミーユ$$ must have had some grievances he couldn't swallow.)

496:t_10:23.en:
$n
(What'll you do, $$ギュネイ$$? $$カミーユ$$'s a tough opponent today.)

496:t_10:24.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Well, what's it going to be, $$ギュネイ$$?」

496:t_10:28.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Fine, $$クェス$$. We're no different, after all.」

496:t_10:30.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Even we don't really know what's right or what's best.」

496:t_10:31.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「That's why we fight, to find it. In other words, you're the same as us.」

496:t_10:35.en:
$$クェス$$
「$$ギュネイ$$ said thank you!」

496:t_10:37.en:
$$シン$$
「That's a relief. You're growing up too.」

496:t_10:38.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Of course. I'm the man who's going to surpass the Colonel.」

496:t_10:40.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Fine. Until the Colonel comes back, I'm counting on you to fill that hole, $$ギュネイ$$.」

496:t_10:41.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Just watch. I'm not going to end up as a stopgap.」

496:t_10:42.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now then, to celebrate Mr. $$ギュネイ$$ joining the unit, I'd like to perform our customary ritual.」

496:t_10:43.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Don't tell me it's that...!?」

496:t_10:44.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Give it up. It's a road every one of us has walked.」

496:t_10:45.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「If you refuse, you'll only be pestered relentlessly.」

496:t_10:47.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then let's get it done quickly! Giving it my all again today...!」

496:t_10:50.en:
$$クェス$$
「Okay, $$ギュネイ$$! From now on, let's work well together again!」

496:t_10:52.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
(Colonel... From today on, I won't chase after your back anymore.)

496:t_10:53.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
(I'll fight shoulder to shoulder with you, and someday I'll surely overtake you...)

496:t_10:60.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「...I wonder what's going to happen to him... after this...」

496:t_10:61.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「His death has not been confirmed, but I believe he will not return to $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

496:t_10:62.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「In his own way, he seemed to understand the words of Mr. $$カミーユ$$ and Mr. $$シャア$$.」

496:t_10:63.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I wonder if what I did was unnecessary meddling...」

496:t_10:65.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If I said that, would you regret it, Mr. $$カミーユ$$?」

496:t_10:67.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then be proud of what you did.」

496:t_10:68.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Reflect, but don't regret... That's how I'd like people to live.」

496:t_10:70.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now that your heart is clear, let's give it our all again today...!」

496:t_10:72.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「How about it? Doesn't shouting loudly clear your head?」

496:t_10:73.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「If I refuse here, you'll keep pestering me forever.」

496:t_10:75.en:
$$カミーユ$$
($$ギュネイ$$... Even if we meet again somewhere someday, I'm sure I won't change the way I live.)

496:t_10:76.en:
$$カミーユ$$
(If you've watched that man's back too, then live honestly by your heart...)

497:t_000:1.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Captain $$ジンネマン$$, I'm counting on you to defend the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$.」

497:t_000:5.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「No... I'm fine. Sorry to make you worry.」

497:t_000:6.en:
$$フォウ$$
「Don't worry about it. We look out for each other, after all.」

497:t_000:7.en:
$$クェス$$
「Right. Besides, you'd better focus on that or it'll be dangerous. $$ギュネイ$$... must be really fired up.」

497:t_000:9.en:
$$カツ$$
「Is that why the Colonel and $$カミーユ$$ teamed up...」

497:t_000:10.en:
$$シャア$$
「Don't worry about me, $$カミーユ$$. Move as you see fit.」

497:t_000:11.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I can't do that. Even I can tell the Colonel is thinking something over.」

497:t_000:13.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Do you know anything, $$シン$$?」

497:t_000:14.en:
$$シン$$
「I haven't heard anything, but if $$カミーユ$$ senses it, there must be something going on.」

497:t_000:15.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That's enough. Now that they've found our base, they may launch a large-scale offensive.」

497:t_000:16.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Still, who'd have thought this thing would be discovered.」

497:t_000:17.en:
$$カトル$$
「Do the $$サイデリアル$$ have some means of seeing through stealth?」

497:t_000:19.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「The $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ serves as an anti-$$ネオ・ジオン$$ base, so people come and go.」

497:t_000:21.en:
$$ノイン$$
「That's not it. As long as people are moving, it's possible that the movement was detected.」

497:t_000:22.en:
$$刹那$$
「For now, we concentrate on intercepting the enemy.」

497:t_000:23.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「My Gundam and $$アレルヤ$$'s have been powered up with additional equipment. I'll show you what they can do.」
